notes: Fix: adding a new scene didn't show up. Removing the Create tab (v1.4.41) deleted the #editor-log element, but addEditorLog() still called el.style.display on it — so it threw inside confirmAddScene() right before the loadSegments() refresh. The scene was created on the backend but the editor/timeline never re-rendered, so it looked like nothing happened (and it left invisible blank scenes behind). Made addEditorLog null-safe, and likewise hardened addRerenderLog() and the render-done fallback branch, which referenced the same removed Create-tab elements (#rerender-log / #rerender-progress-bar / #rerender-status). Adding a scene now refreshes correctly.
